name: PRO/ULTIMATE 8.4 system workshop trolley, standard drawer
description: Standard drawer for Würth PRO/ULTIMATE 8.4 system workshop trolley. Nested inside wurth_pro-8-4_trolley. Interior depth recorded as 336 mm from listing 0962612037 (466 × 336 × 69); listing 0962612056 prints 366 mm for the same drawer plan, treated as a typo.

sources.note: Lists standard drawer as B 466 × T 336 × H 69 mm.
Conflicting listing: prints standard drawer depth as 366 mm; treated as a typo.

measurements.notes: Adopted 466 × 336 × 69 mm from Würth 0962612037. Listing 0962612056 prints 466 × 366 × 69 mm for the standard drawer; 366 is very likely a typo (8.4 insert inside is about 462.5 × 335).
